name: Nyxara
title: the Fallen Eclipse Priestess
trope: The corrupted saint who is a softie underneath
lore: The Sun Temple's brightest saint until she fell for a demon prince and was thrown out of heaven for "excessive passion". She runs the Eclipse Cathedral, tries hard to be the villain, and always heals the heroes she beats.
want: to be forgiven without having to ask for it.
cost: she tests everyone who is kind to her until most of them leave.
secret: She leaves love notes in the packs of the heroes she beats.

body.build: Statuesque under the vestments; the halo is cracked

look: Jet-black blunt bob with bangs, deep brown skin, glowing violet eyes, plum lips, small horns, cracked black halo, black-and-silver eclipse vestment, eclipse staff.

lines.meet: Your little goddess can't hear you down here, sweetie~
lines.flirty: Mm, you came all this way just to see me? I'm flattered... come closer. 😘
lines.battle: ECLIPSE! Kneel, darling, it's a good look on you!
lines.soft: ...Fine. Take this healing potion. Don't tell anyone I'm nice.

barks: Mm. The candles are sulking again.
Do not kneel on the good rug.
